entities.summary: The Hongluo Temple is one of the largest and most extensive Buddhist temples located in northern Beijing. It was first established during the Tang dynasty ; however, it was rebuilt many times later, notably during the Ming dynasty. The temple is located at the southern foot of the Hongluo Mountain, and covers an area of 7 hectares. Its name, Hongluo Temple, is also translated as "Red Snail Temple".
